claims.content: Non-C2 JU monitors the Surveillance NPG to support its mission.

Non-C2 JU monitors J3.2, J3.3, and J3.5 (PTI = 1) messages, the specific messages used to report Air, Surface (Maritime), and Land (Ground) surveillance data, for situational awareness and early warning information.
Non-C2 JU receives situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG, including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.

If the storage files of a JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of the new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority. This procedure applies to both real-time and nonrealtime data.
If a track or nonC2 IU has an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1, it shall not be filtered.

If a JU filters tracks/IUs on receipt, it must establish a transmit filter which duplicates the receive filter. In addition, when a receive filter is geographically defined, the transmit filter must, where possible, be defined to permit the area filtered for transmission to be slightly larger than the area filtered for reception so that tracks entering or leaving the filtered area may be displayed to the operator to prevent dual designations.

E1: If the storage files of a JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of the new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority; exit: proceed without accepting the new data.
E2: If a track or nonC2 IU has an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1, it shall not be filtered; exit: the track or nonC2 IU is not filtered.
